image_description: A side-profile view of an adult bison standing on a gravel path next to a grassy field. The background features rolling hills and sparse trees under a blue sky. A second, smaller bison is visible in the distant background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile; it is large and broad relative to the body, and short, dark, curved horns are distinct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, shaggy beard hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with bison anatomy.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, though resolution limits detailed inspection, it matches the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick fur of the head/hump transition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build, appearing heavy and robust, particularly around the shoulder region.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a very clear, high shoulder hump covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur, which is the defining feature of the species.
The fur on the rear half of the body is visibly shorter and smoother compared to the dense mane and hump on the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively small and curved, proportionate to the massive size of the head and body.
The legs appear thick and sturdy. While the hooves are partially obscured by grass/gravel, the visible lower leg structure is consistent with sturdy bovid limbs.
The tail is visible hanging down, ending in a distinct dark, bushy tuft.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and their connection to the massive torso, ensuring no limb fusion or missing parts.
To check for edge bleeding between the shaggy fur and the background, a common AI artifact in hairy subjects.
To assess overall texture consistency, lighting coherence, and detect any subtle generative noise or blur.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency (shaggy vs smooth transition)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the shaggy forequarter fur and the smoother hindquarter fur. AI models often struggle with this textural gradient, resulting in 'melting' or inconsistent density. Also, verify that the legs do not merge into the belly fur or the ground shadow.
